description: STPoa - Sistema de Transporte Público de Porto Alegre is a dataset listed in City of Porto Alegre open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by EPTC. Dados referentes aos ônibus, lotações, táxis e transportes escolares, informados pelo Sistema de Transporte Público de Porto Alegre (STPoa). Coverage: Porto Alegre. The portal files it under the publisher EPTC. It offers 14 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-poa-portal.
